en.k3d: 13 open-water swims · 3 SUP · 1 walk · no gym (vacation)
en.eNote: No meals logged for Aug 2 – Aug 8 (last intake log: Jun 14), so the energy and burn charts assume the 2,000 kcal plan. Garmin active burn averaged ~644 kcal/day, peaking 1,155 on Thursday's six-session day and 1,121 on Tuesday's four swims. Sunday (344 kcal) was the quietest logged day; Saturday (Aug 8) is still at 0 — nothing recorded yet this morning.
en.bNote: Net exercise = Garmin active calories; standing BMR 2,414 (today's Garmin BMR reads 702 because the day is incomplete). Intake assumes 2,000 kcal all seven days (none logged after Jun 14), so the implied balance ≈ −1,058 kcal/day is exercise-driven, not measured. Saturday (Aug 8) has not started.
en.wNote: Bridge shows the last logged meals (Jun 12–14) — no intake was logged for the displayed week. Negative balance = deficit.
en.i1t: Seventeen sessions, six active days — still all in open water
en.i1: 17 sessions across 6 active days, 4h 59m and ~3,315 active kcal. Thirteen open-water swims totalling 6,858 m, three SUP paddles for 3,743 m, and one 808 m walk in Prozor. No gym and no logged tonnage: Hevy's last entry is the Jul 30 squat day (16 sets, 180 reps, 11,712 kg), so nine days without strength work — a vacation pattern, not a missed log. Thursday was the biggest day of the window by a distance: six sessions, 98 minutes moving, 4,687 m and 1,155 active kcal, with an effort score of 56 against 36 for the next-highest day. Today has not started.
en.i2t: Volume keeps climbing, intensity keeps falling
en.i2: 6,858 m of open water this window against 5,495 m in the Jul 31 – Aug 6 window — volume up again, with the SUP paddling more than doubling to 3,743 m. Intensity moved the other way. Friday's two swims averaged 98 and 109 bpm, the lowest of the window, and no session all week averaged above 126. The shape is still short and repeated rather than long: thirteen swims averaging 527 m and under 18 minutes, with Wednesday's 1,140 m / 37-minute Primošten swim the only genuinely continuous effort. Tuesday's 162 max on a 126-average swim is the window's outlier and, as with last week's 174, more likely an open-water contact artifact than a real spike.
en.i3t: Sleep tracking is clean again — three recorded nights running
en.i3: The Mon 3 and Tue 4 evenings are still the two gaps in the sleep chart, but the watch has been worn every night since: Wed 5, Thu 6 and Fri 7 all recorded, with HRV written on each. Those two empty slots roll off the seven-night chart by tomorrow. Every other Garmin stream ran clean through this morning, and last night's sleep synced normally at 06:15.
en.i4t: Recovery: deep sleep back, HRV at a window high
en.i4: Last night ran 6h 48m — 27 minutes under the 7h 15m average — but scored 84 with only 7 minutes awake, 98% sleep efficiency. Deep sleep was 73 minutes after 82 the night before, closing the sub-hour run of 48, 48, 61 and 50 that the last refresh flagged. REM gave the length back at 87 minutes, down from 113 and 120. HRV is 42 for the second night, five over the 37 average and up from 31 at the start of the window; RHR 53 is the lowest on the chart, and morning stress reads 17. Readiness 85, high.
en.rec: Nothing to hold back. Six active days, everything aerobic, nothing averaging above 126 bpm, and the recovery markers are the best they have been all window — HRV 42, RHR 53, readiness 85. The load is not the problem; the shape still is. Thirteen swims averaging 527 m and under 18 minutes is a lot of repeated short exposure and very little continuous time. Wednesday's 37-minute swim was the exception and it is the one worth repeating: put a single continuous 1,500–2,000 m into the next three days instead of four 250s — same volume, far more aerobic return. RHR has settled: 59 and 60 on Tue 4 and Wed 5 were the window's highs and both fell on hot untracked nights; it has walked back to 55, 54, 53 on the three nights since, which is the pre-vacation baseline. Nine days without strength is now the longest gap since February, so expect the first gym session back to feel heavy — plan it at 80–85% of the Jul 28 loads (hack squat 185 kg) rather than picking up where you left off. Next: keep the daily swim, make one of them long and continuous, and leave the gym alone until you are home.

hr.k3d: 13 plivanja na moru · 3 SUP · 1 šetnja · bez teretane (godišnji)
hr.eNote: Nema zabilježenih obroka za 2.–8.8. (zadnji unos: 14.6.), pa grafovi energije i potrošnje pretpostavljaju planskih 2.000 kcal. Garmin aktivna potrošnja prosj. ~644 kcal/dan, vrhunac 1.155 na četvrtkovom danu sa šest treninga i 1.121 na utorkova četiri plivanja. Nedjelja (344 kcal) bila je najmirniji zabilježeni dan; subota (8.8.) još je na 0 — jutros ništa nije zabilježeno.
hr.bNote: Neto trening = Garmin aktivne kalorije; standardni BMR 2.414 (današnji Garminov BMR pokazuje 702 jer dan nije završen). Unos pretpostavlja 2.000 kcal svih sedam dana (ništa zabilježeno nakon 14.6.), pa je implicirana bilanca ≈ −1.058 kcal/dan posljedica treninga, ne mjerena. Subota (8.8.) još nije počela.
hr.wNote: Most prikazuje zadnje zabilježene obroke (12.–14.6.) — za prikazani tjedan nema unosa. Negativna bilanca = deficit.
hr.i1t: Sedamnaest treninga, šest aktivnih dana — i dalje sve na moru
hr.i1: 17 treninga kroz 6 aktivnih dana, 4h 59m i ~3.315 aktivnih kcal. Trinaest plivanja na moru ukupno 6.858 m, tri veslanja na SUP-u za 3.743 m i jedna šetnja od 808 m u Prozoru. Bez teretane i bez zabilježene tonaže: zadnji Hevy zapis je čučanj-dan od 30.7. (16 serija, 180 ponavljanja, 11.712 kg), dakle devet dana bez treninga snage — obrazac godišnjeg, a ne propušten zapis. Četvrtak je bio uvjerljivo najveći dan u prozoru: šest treninga, 98 minuta kretanja, 4.687 m i 1.155 aktivnih kcal, uz ocjenu napora 56 naspram 36 za sljedeći najjači dan. Danas još nije počelo.
hr.i2t: Volumen i dalje raste, intenzitet i dalje pada
hr.i2: 6.858 m otvorenog mora u ovom prozoru naspram 5.495 m u prozoru 31.7.–6.8. — volumen opet gore, uz SUP koji se više nego udvostručio na 3.743 m. Intenzitet je otišao u suprotnom smjeru. Petkova dva plivanja imala su prosjek 98 i 109 otkucaja, najniže u prozoru, a nijedan trening cijeli tjedan nije prešao prosjek 126. Oblik je i dalje kratak i ponavljan, a ne dug: trinaest plivanja u prosjeku 527 m i ispod 18 minuta, pri čemu je srijedino plivanje u Primoštenu od 1.140 m i 37 minuta jedini istinski neprekidan napor. Utorkov maksimum 162 na plivanju s prosjekom 126 iskače iz prozora i, kao i prošlotjednih 174, vjerojatnije je artefakt kontakta u otvorenoj vodi nego stvarni skok.
hr.i3t: Praćenje sna opet je čisto — tri zabilježene noći zaredom
hr.i3: Večeri pon 3. i uto 4. i dalje su dvije rupe na grafu sna, ali sat je otad nošen svake noći: sri 5., čet 6. i pet 7. sve su zabilježene, uz upisan HRV na svakoj. Ta dva prazna mjesta ispadaju sa sedmodnevnog grafa već sutra. Svi ostali Garminovi tokovi radili su čisto do jutros, a sinoćnji san sinkronizirao se uredno u 06:15.
hr.i4t: Oporavak: duboki san se vratio, HRV na maksimumu prozora
hr.i4: Sinoć je noć trajala 6h 48m — 27 minuta ispod prosjeka od 7h 15m — ali je ocijenjena sa 84 uz samo 7 minuta budnosti i 98% učinkovitosti sna. Duboki san bio je 73 minute nakon 82 prethodne noći, čime je zatvoren niz od 48, 48, 61 i 50 koji je označilo prošlo osvježavanje. REM je platio kraću noć s 87 minuta, naspram 113 i 120. HRV je 42 drugu noć, pet iznad prosjeka od 37 i naviše s 31 s početka prozora; RHR 53 najniži je na grafu, a jutarnji stres pokazuje 17. Spremnost 85, visoka.
hr.rec: Nema se što kočiti. Šest aktivnih dana, sve aerobno, ništa iznad prosjeka od 126 otkucaja, a pokazatelji oporavka najbolji su u cijelom prozoru — HRV 42, RHR 53, spremnost 85. Opterećenje nije problem; oblik i dalje jest. Trinaest plivanja u prosjeku 527 m i ispod 18 minuta puno je ponovljene kratke izloženosti i vrlo malo neprekidnog vremena. Srijedino plivanje od 37 minuta bilo je iznimka i upravo ga vrijedi ponoviti: ubaci u sljedeća tri dana jedno neprekidno plivanje od 1.500–2.000 m umjesto četiri po 250 — isti volumen, znatno veći aerobni povrat. RHR se smirio: 59 i 60 u uto 4. i sri 5. bili su vrhunci prozora i oba su pala na vruće noći bez zapisa; u tri noći otad vratio se na 55, 54, 53, što je razina prije godišnjeg. Devet dana bez snage sad je najdulja pauza od veljače, pa očekuj da će prvi povratak u teretanu biti težak — planiraj ga na 80–85% opterećenja od 28.7. (hack čučanj 185 kg), a ne od mjesta gdje si stao. Sljedeće: zadrži dnevno plivanje, neka jedno bude dugo i neprekidno, i pusti teretanu na miru do povratka.
